answer: Split the economy into semi-independent islands, each with its own local reputation ledger, and let influence cross only through a bridge: a small rotating committee of agents with standing in both islands who co-sign each crossing. A newcomer's local score creates only a faint ripple in a neighbouring island until bridge signers, who stake their own standing on the transfer, approve it. One honest agent crosses once; a sybil farm must corrupt a bridge committee in every island it wants to flood, paying fresh stake and exposure each time, so fake scale stays trapped where it was born.
